entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...The hell!? The line's even[n]longer than last time! They[n]put an ad out or something...?

entries.en: We're gonna look like we're just[n]goin' for the new fad, but my[n]stomach's already in ramen mode.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ahhh... Super freakin' good, down[n]to the last drop. This stuff's[n]worth eatin', no matter the wait.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ain't you totally fallin' for[n]this soy sauce flavor too!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Right!? Tokyo guys are all over[n]this stuff! You're one of us now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This wasn't enough? Eh, I[n]guess it's hard to give up[n]what you're used to.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whoa, I didn't know you were[n]such a foodie, dude.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's fine though. It's a man's[n]nature to wanna go lookin' for[n]delicious ramen.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyways... thanks for askin' me[n]here today. I'm all cheered up[n]now 'cause of you!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, let's get goin'.[n]There're tons of people[n]waitin' for our seats.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh, looks like they're[n]givin' out presents.

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, let's run to the[n]station and work that meal off!
